review.selectedRoute: Reuse existing Laurent coefficient transport and composition for the same actual rational integral-ratio fields. A single coefficient map covers arithmetic automorphisms and the fixed complex embedding. Reuse the original inverse coefficient place construction, uniqueness of discrete order, finite-coordinate closed residues, finite divisor transport and native quotient functoriality. The existing place-restriction and ramification argument proves both divisor naturality identities; the actual inclusion/substitution compatibility discharges their field-commutation input. Explicit composition and representative evaluation avoid opaque rewrite matching without changing limits. These subgroup parameters are used for Gamma1 and its actual Hecke subgroup, not an unrelated generalization.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: Actual coefficient transport preserves the same rational modular integral-ratio field. Arithmetic automorphisms fix the original j and commute with both literal Hecke field maps. Their genuine permutation of places preserves normalized orders and induces additive divisor transport preserving principal divisors and degree zero. The action descends to the actual Gamma1 Picard group, satisfies the group action laws, preserves every n-torsion subgroup, and commutes with the actual finite Hecke correspondence. Translation/finite-index and residue hypotheses are derived for the actual Gamma1 consumer. No field-commutation, ramification-invariance, divisor-naturality, degree/principal preservation, Picard-action or arithmetic Hecke-equivariance premise remains.
review.remaining: Geometric/H1 and diamond comparison, Frobenius/inertia, arithmetic Galois realization of the original finite characters, original all-weight characteristic-zero association, required local/image/regularity, arithmetic automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain required. The Picard coefficient action is not itself the original all-weight associated representation. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
